Read only: nothing is written to the car. Start recording, tap the flag at the top (“Mark”) before each action (switch the ignition off, open a door, connect the phone), then save the files to a USB drive with the floppy icon.

No car API in this firmware

Car Diagnostics shows which car data and events are available to apps on the Evolute i-Space head unit. Read only: nothing is written to the car.

Start recording background recording of car property changes, power and sleep states, broadcasts, Settings keys and system properties. A snapshot is taken right away; recording continues after a reboot and sleep until you stop it.

Buttons at the top (long-press shows the name):
⚑ Mark in the log: mark a moment before an action, e.g. “opening the door now”.
📷 Take a snapshot of the car: all properties of the car service with their current values, Settings keys, system properties.
💾 Save the log and snapshots to a USB drive or internal memory.
🗑 Clear the log (snapshots are kept).

Tokens, numbers, addresses, identifiers and the VIN are not written to the files. Still, review the files before sharing them.

⚠ Unofficial app, use at your own risk.

EISDiag is an unofficial application. It is not affiliated with, endorsed or supported by the Evolute car manufacturer, its dealers or the head unit suppliers.

The application runs with system privileges and reads data of the car and the head unit; it writes nothing to the car or the stock software.

The software is provided “as is”, without warranty of any kind. You install and use it at your own risk. The author is not liable for any damage, including malfunction of the head unit or other vehicle systems, loss of data or settings, the need to reset or reflash the unit, refusal of warranty service, and any consequences while operating the vehicle.

Firmware updates or the manufacturer’s server may make the application stop working, or make the data it collects incomplete or inaccurate.

Diagnostic files may contain information about the car and connected devices. Review them before sharing.

Do not use the application while driving, only while the vehicle is stationary.
